description: Get Figma file metadata including name, creator, last modification details, thumbnail, and access information. Use when you need quick file overview without the full document tree.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for retrieving metadata of a Figma file.

file_key.description: File key to get metadata for. This can be a file key or branch key. Extract from file URL: https://www.figma.com/design/{file_key}/... or https://www.figma.com/file/{file_key}/... Use `GET /v1/files/:key` with the `branch_data` query param to get the branch key.
file_key.title: File Key

inputSchema.title: GetFileMetadataRequest

name: get_file_metadata

EditorType.description: The type of editor associated with the file.
EditorType.title: EditorType

GetFileMetadataResponse.description: Response schema containing metadata for a Figma file.

creator.description: Details of the user who created the file.
creator.title: Creator

editorType.title: Editor Type

folder_name.description: The name of the project containing the file.
folder_name.title: Folder Name

last_touched_at.description: The UTC ISO 8601 time at which the file content was last modified.
last_touched_at.title: Last Touched At

last_touched_by.description: Details of the user who last modified the file.
last_touched_by.title: Last Touched By
